verdict: Task sequence from stand-alone media failed to install an application because the Software Distribution Client agent is not enabled. Standalone media clients start without policy, so the SWDist agent flag is not set.
fix: Add a `Run Command Line` step BEFORE any `Install Application` or `Install Package` step, running: `WMIC /namespace:\\root\ccm\policy\machine\requestedconfig path ccm_SoftwareDistributionClientConfig CREATE ComponentName='Enable SWDist', Enabled='true', LockSettings='TRUE', PolicySource='local', PolicyVersion='1.0', SiteSettingsKey='1' /NOINTERACTIVE`. Rebuild the standalone media after the change. Full network-based task sequences do not need this; it is a standalone-media-only workaround.
